maddeler.e:
صتتن (form I)
# صَتَتُّنَّ (ṣatattunna) /sˤa.tat.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of صَتَّ (ṣatta)
# صَتَتْنَ (ṣatatna) /sˤa.tat.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of صَتَّ (ṣatta)
# صُتِتُّنَّ (ṣutittunna) /sˤu.tit.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of صَتَّ (ṣatta)
# صُتِتْنَ (ṣutitna) /sˤu.tit.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of صَتَّ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
